items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: But like my brother Pete, he was one of the key men.

ctx.x: Did you ever have a tryout for the George White Scandals show? Well, no, uh...

The George White Scandals. That's, I think I mentioned that. Mm-hmm. We did try out. But after trying out, the men didn't want to stay. Piron couldn't get them to stay. Up there, you know. Some of them had good jobs here. In fact, we were making lots of money here. We just went mostly on a trip. But then that was his greatest ambition was to reach the top. And in fact, it hurted him, you know, when the men actually turned him down. Cause he said he could have went to such great heights, you know. Had they would…
Were these other fellas longer than you?
